profiles.summary: Gusto is an Italian restaurant and pizzeria in central Tel Aviv, at Frishman 90 on the south-west corner of Rabin Square. The menu covers antipasti, salads, pasta, filled pasta, gnocchi, pizza, a few meat and fish mains, wine, beer and cocktails; gnocchi and pasta dishes are available gluten-free. The restaurant states it is not kosher and offers take-away, delivery and event bookings.

profiles.summary: Manhattan Dental Arts is a dental practice at 1995 Broadway, Suite 200, on the Upper West Side of Manhattan (ZIP 10023). It offers general, cosmetic, restorative and oral-surgery dentistry, including implants, veneers, Invisalign, root canals and same-day crowns. Four dentists are named on the site; appointments are booked by phone or online through Zocdoc.
services: General: dental exams and X-rays, teeth cleaning, dental sealants, oral cancer screening, sedation dentistry, sleep apnea therapy, emergency dental care
Cosmetic: cosmetic bonding, porcelain veneers, smile makeovers, teeth whitening
Restorative: crowns and Crown In a Day, dental bridges, dental implants, dentures, tooth fillings, root canals, gum recontouring, periodontics
Orthodontics and Invisalign / clear aligners
Oral surgery: tooth extractions, wisdom tooth extraction, TMJ & TMD treatment
profiles.prices: Published offers (site, seasonal-offers page): $199 New Patient Special (cleaning, exam and X-ray); $5,000 Clear Aligners (comprehensive case); 15% off dental treatment over $2,500 for new patients (offer valid 12/01/2026–12/31/2026, conditions apply, not combinable with insurance); Dental Savings Plans: Adult Complete $475/year, Perio $825/year. Financing via Sunbit. No other fees published.
profiles.booking: Online via Zocdoc (https://www.zocdoc.com/practice/manhattan-dental-arts-60877); phone (212) 247-2330; appointment request form on the Contact Us page

profiles.name: Kosma Hair Studio
profiles.address: 9 דוידקה, Tel-Aviv, IL, 6742158 (Davidka St 9, Tel Aviv 6742158)
profiles.summary: Kosma Hair Studio TLV is a private one-chair hair studio at Davidka St 9 in the Yad Eliyahu neighbourhood of Tel Aviv, set in a garden. It offers custom haircuts with scalp and hair analysis, Korean (K-Beauty) hair care and Japanese-style head spa treatments, and hair-care consultations. Appointments are booked online through the studio's SimplyBook.me booking page, by phone or WhatsApp.
services: Custom Cut incl. hair & scalp analysis and K-Beauty spa care — 2 hr — ₪350
K-Beauty Hair Care & Japanese Relax Head Spa — 1 hr 30 min — ₪350
Korean Hair Care Routine (scalp/hair diagnosis and home-care plan, digital guide, no product sales) — 1 hr — ₪200
Custom Dry Touch-Up (refresh of an existing cut, dry hair only, no wash) — 1 hr — ₪200
Consultation (Shape | Color | Recovery), online or in studio — ₪200
Techniques named on the site: Dry Cut for curly hair, razor technique for fine hair, Wash & Go cuts
profiles.prices: ₪200–₪350 per service as listed on the online booking page (Custom Cut ₪350; Head Spa ₪350; Korean Hair Care Routine ₪200; Dry Touch-Up ₪200; Consultation ₪200). Cancellation policy: changes/cancellations up to 48 hours ahead; later cancellation charged 50% of the service price.
profiles.booking: Online at https://kosmahair.com/v2/book/ (SimplyBook.me); phone or WhatsApp +972543048197; email kosmatics@gmail.com
languages: Hebrew (website and booking page; service names in English)
extras: Parking: accessible, convenient parking in the studio's surroundings (site)
Pets: the space is shared with animals; visitors with allergies are asked to prepare; friendly pets welcome if the atmosphere stays quiet
Private studio with a garden; the site describes it as open to all genders, ages, religions and nationalities
Products described as Korean, natural, vegan and ecological
profiles.discrepancies: Maps 'closes 8 pm' matches the site (20:00) for Sun–Thu, but the site shows the studio closed Fri and Sat and opening only at 14:00 on Mon and Wed. The site names no stylist: it says the studio is run by a hair designer who graduated from Bezalel's fashion department and hair-design academies (no name published); customer reviews on the page mention a first name, but reviews are excluded by rule. No founding year, no wheelchair-accessibility statement. Site is a SimplyBook.me booking site rendered client-side; plain HTTP fetch returns an empty shell, data was read via a rendered browser page.
